claim: CodeVetter can classify one material non-overlapping Node pre-commit interval by observed process CPU pressure without retaining absolute counters or assigning exclusive CPU, waiting, framework, or source causation.

retained_values: user and system CPU deltas in milliseconds
bounded whole-request and pre-commit overlap counts
discarded_values: request identities used for overlap tracking

proofs: Response behavior is preserved while process CPU deltas are captured.
Overlapping pre-commit intervals contaminate both requests.
Overlap beginning after commitment contaminates whole-request CPU without erasing the earlier isolated interval.
High, low, mixed, malformed, incomplete, overlapping, and immaterial cases follow the closed policy.

flow.name: home renders
flow.failure_boundary: The existing exact Playwright assertion failed, so the CPU shape remains diagnostic only.

diagnosis.result: Observed process CPU was between the fixed low and high thresholds, so CodeVetter requested a narrower probe instead of claiming CPU-bound or wait-bound execution.

limitations: Process CPU is not exclusive request CPU and can include worker threads or unrelated background work.
Zero admitted pre-commit overlap does not exclude background process work.
The mixed classification does not identify compilation, rendering, I/O, async waiting, or a source cause.
The async inventory was incomplete and overlapping delays are not additive exclusive work.
The exact browser assertion failed, so this capture authorizes no source edit or optimization claim.
